headline: Argentina Sovereign Risk Index Exceeds 1,000 Basis Points on Bond Selloff
summary: Argentina's country risk index calculated by JP Morgan surpassed 1,000 basis points, reaching a 13-month high following sovereign bond price declines that complicate debt refinancing terms.
why: The EMBI country risk index measures the yield spread of sovereign dollar bonds over US Treasuries.

impacts.name: Argentina Sovereign Bond Yield
impacts.why: Lower bond prices elevated sovereign borrowing yields and widened spreads.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Argentine sovereign debt prices dropped, sending country risk metrics above key threshold levels.
